Name: Statue Blessing For All
Author: coreyon
Description:
Enables use of Statues such as Statue of Blessings and Statue Of The Dwarf King regardless even though the player does not have the Farming mastery or Mining Mastery. Essentially bypassing the mastery check to use these items.

Helps for multiplayer play so that you can share the statue to those that don't have the masteries yet.
